subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: Should the WhatsApp Desktop identity apply only to new pairings, or should existing linked sessions be detected and guided through a mandatory re-pair migration?
rationale: The identity is registered at pairing time: the demonstrated fix requires re-pairing, while applying the new identity to old credentials reportedly enters a 428 setup loop. Code alone cannot choose the acceptable upgrade behavior for existing users.

options.title: Guided re-pair migration
options.body: Adopt the Desktop identity and add Doctor/setup detection with clear in-product re-pair guidance for incompatible existing sessions.

options.title: New pairings only
options.body: Use the Desktop identity only for newly paired accounts and leave existing credentials unchanged, accepting that affected sessions remain broken until manually re-linked.

options.title: Keep current identity
options.body: Retain current behavior while seeking a different upstream fix that does not alter the registered linked-device identity.

recommendation.title: Guided re-pair migration
recommendation.body: Adopt the Desktop identity and add Doctor/setup detection with clear in-product re-pair guidance for incompatible existing sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent WhatsApp packaging and release-level history makes this person the strongest available owner for an upgrade-sensitive channel default decision.
